result: Exact rmcp-v3.1.4 release source shows ServerHandler exposes overrideable get_task/update_task/cancel_task methods whose signatures do not depend on TaskManager; tasks/get returns GetTaskResult, while update/cancel return unit and the dispatcher emits the task acknowledgement. Exact task models expose Task::new, DetailedTask::new, GetTaskResult::new, and TaskAckResult::new. Therefore already-persisted task state can be served from an application-owned durable store without stock TaskManager. This does not prove durable creation, restart redrive, or exactly-once effects.
